newsitem.title: USA: Cal-Maine upbeat on favorable feed prices.
newsitem.headline: Cal-Maine upbeat on favorable feed prices.

text.p: Cal-Maine Foods Inc said Monday current feed prices are down sharply compared with the first and second fiscal quarters and should remain favorable for the rest of the fiscal year which ends May 31, 1997.

The producer and seller of fresh shell eggs and egg products on Monday reported that second quarter net income rose to $5.9 million or $0.52 per share, compared to $3.7 million or $0.31 per share for the year-ago quarter.
"We are optimistic in our outlook for the second half of fiscal 1997," the company said in a release.
